product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides construction management software for small and mid-sized commercial general contractors to manage projects, financials, documents and team coordination in one connected platform.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing is structured around Active Project Value.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in customer testimonials linked to case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 98 employees; LeadIQ reports approximately 99 as of August 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The readable Builder Blog index contains construction-industry content, not qualifying engineering posts about building RedTeam.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center contains hundreds of articles across RedTeam Go, RedTeam Flex and other products.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public job board says no jobs are posted. A separate accessible Account Executive application exists, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science role was found.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services — Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Textract
model_provider.notes: An implementation case study featuring RedTeam's CTO identifies these services; it does not name the underlying foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy describes security safeguards but does not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS compliance.

last_funding.notes: The funding history identifies February 2, 2022 as the latest Series B round; contemporaneous reporting gives the amount as $28 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round was February 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive – SMB posting has an accessible application form, although the general job board separately reports no openings.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying major launch was found for May 9–November 9, 2026. The recent releases concern reporting refinements, administrative controls, sync fixes and UI changes; the substantive Offline Mode launch was January 7, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: RedTeam announced Connor Schone's appointment as Vice President of Finance on July 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Account Executive posting explicitly requires maintaining leads, opportunities and account information in HubSpot.
